about: Every hard-check implementation (Swift app, Python CLI) must give exactly these results, failures in the order dropped, answers, question, numbers, negation, identifiers, new_words. 'replies' test reading the model's raw reply (hit_limit = generation stopped at max_tokens); 'checks' test the checks.
